fields.field: Clinical phenotypes reported in affected individuals with exact counts (numerator and denominator per cohort, not just percentage), original paper wording, and standard HPO terms where identifiable
Source attribution for every phenotype frequency linking it to a specific cohort and a paper with a PMID or DOI
Most discriminating findings present in most affected individuals but uncommon in overlapping disorders, along with the names of those disorders and the confidence level of the distinction
Findings explicitly evaluated and found absent in affected individuals whose presence argues against the diagnosis
Analysis of whether the phenotype varies by variant type, variant position, age, or sex
Discrepant or contradictory findings reported between different papers
